title: KR2 VM SSH/ICMP Health Check
description: Real-time SSH and ICMP connectivity monitoring for 1,000+ VMs with alert statistics
note: Internal hostnames, datasource UIDs, and alertmanager URLs have been sanitized. Replace placeholders before use.
panels: On Init Graphic: JS pulse animation — panel border turns red if SSH unhealthy > 12 or ICMP unhealthy > 8
Domain Summary: SSH Healthcheck stat, ICMP Healthcheck stat, SSH/ICMP Status Summary table
Project Summary: Per-project SSH/ICMP healthy/unhealthy counts + detail tables
Alert Summary: Total Fired/Resolved/Active, Alert by Category bar chart, Currently Active Alerts table, Top Hosts by Alert Count, Alert Statistics by Category
datasources: Infinity — REST API calls to kakao-webhook /stats/* endpoints

special_features.JS_DOM_manipulation: gapit-htmlgraphics-panel injects CSS animations into parent Grafana window via window.parent
special_features.pulse_animation: Panel border pulses red when unhealthy count exceeds threshold (SSH>12, ICMP>8)
special_features.dual_datasource: Prometheus for metrics + Infinity plugin for REST API (alertmanager webhook stats)
